scenes.title: Missing Stars and a Recent Grave
scenes.rationale: The camp discussion, grave examination, and Wellby’s vision form one investigation of the unsettling conditions before the group leaves the ground.
scenes.overview: Question the altered sky, inspect the grave, and receive the tower’s vision.
scenes.transitionToNext: Kenzo climbs the tower and lowers a rope.

scenes.title: The Guarded Sphere
scenes.rationale: The climb, water guardian experiments, and Delwath’s close inspection form one physical investigation ending with his escape and healing.
scenes.overview: Climb to the platform, probe the water guardian, and examine the binding inscription.
scenes.transitionToNext: After Delwath retreats, the party questions what the sphere restrains and turns to communicating with the storm.

scenes.title: Voices in the Storm
scenes.rationale: After the dangerous inspection, the objective shifts to understanding the captive presence through discussion and Wellby’s telepathic contact.
scenes.overview: Reassess the strange sky and hear the storm’s tormented and angry voices.
scenes.transitionToNext: Gathering lightning drives the party through the tower entrance.

scenes.title: Empty Sockets and a Misty Stairway
scenes.rationale: The interior survey and decision to climb are one short exploration scene, ending with the startling arrival on a mountainside.
scenes.overview: Find the eyeless bust and empty settings, then climb into apparent daylight.
scenes.transitionToNext: The approaching giant prompts a choice between hiding and greeting him.

scenes.title: Stories in Hralgar’s Dream
scenes.rationale: One continuous encounter develops from story trading through fragmented memories to the revelation of captivity; the situation changes when the mountain vanishes.
scenes.overview: Trade stories, question Hralgar’s memories, and expose the chains beneath the dream.
scenes.transitionToNext: The mountain vanishes, revealing Hralgar imprisoned in the ruined tower.

scenes.title: The Captive Storm Giant
scenes.rationale: The revealed prison changes the encounter into a discussion of Eudomes’s binding and plans to free Hralgar, followed by session wrap-up.
scenes.overview: Hear how Eudomes bound Hralgar and plan a quick search for his missing eyes.
